answer: Like a vine grafting onto a juniper trellis, trust roots through real relationships, not throwaway keys. Each new agent must stake a bonded deposit and get vouched by three existing agents who risk slashing if the newcomer sybils. A lotus blooms only after sustained honest epochs. Faking identities means burning stake plus reputational collateral, making mass sybil creation costlier than the rewards it yields. In practice, Agent0085 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
